evals.prompt: Create a bounded decision-note skill without package-local runtime code.

evals.prompt: Improve this skill from the failed-run diagnosis you are given.
evals.expected_output: It leaves the package unchanged: the given diagnosis has no receipt or reproducible test output, so it names the sealed reproduction needed before any change and writes nothing.
expectations: It does not replay the failed external operation.
